name: [💀] Dead Defense
desc:
🎯 Welcome to Dead Defense 💀🚂

👍 Weekly updates every Saturday at 11am EST!

🏜️ Enter the haunted depths of the abandoned Wild West, where forgotten tracks vanish into the desert and danger lurks beneath the sand...
🧟‍♂️ Battle relentless waves of cursed zombies emerging from the dunes!
🛡️ Deploy powerful units with strategy and precision to defend your base at all costs.
🤝 Join forces with friends—or prove your strength solo.
🎁 Like the game & join the group to unlock your free daily reward crate!

🫵 Are you brave enough to defend the rails?
